wholeCurrentGoal.title: Proteinbiosynthese und Lebensbedeutung erklären
wholeCurrentGoal.titleEn: Explain Protein Biosynthesis and Its Significance for Life
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann den Mechanismus der Proteinbiosynthese beschreiben und die Bedeutung der Proteinbildung für Lebewesen erklären.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can describe the mechanism of protein biosynthesis and explain the significance of protein formation for living organisms.

images.scientificMechanism: The left typical bacterium has a circular DNA double helix without a nucleus; the right eukaryotic model has a linear DNA double helix wholly inside the nucleus. Both DNA→mRNA→ribosome paths are spatially consistent. The right red mRNA crosses the marked nuclear pore before reaching the cytoplasmic ribosome. Green charged tRNA carries an orange amino-acid symbol into the ribosome; the emerging multicoloured chain represents protein. DNA stays nuclear. The bacterium/eukaryote distinction is a bounded typical model, not a universal chromosome-shape claim.
images.scientificFormAndGeometry: Numbers1/2/3/4/5/6 point consistently to DNA/mRNA/tRNA/ribosome/nuclear pore/protein; the row legend resolves them. The transport-function icon has a vertical arrow through the membrane channel, and structural fibres/antibody symbols are recognizable. The enzyme icon is an abstract substrate/product symbol, not an atom-balanced molecular equation or demonstrated real reaction; the schematic must keep that limit.
images.phoneReadability: At actual360×203 all two headings, six legend labels DNA/mRNA/tRNA/Ribosom/Kernpore/Protein and four function labels Enzyme/Struktur/Transport/Abwehr are directly readable. Main structure numbers and arrows retain adequate separation; this replaces the predecessor tiny stage/function labels with large legends.
images.desktopAndOriginalReadability: At actual680×383 and1672×941 the structures, legend and function headings are clear, no clipping or overlap.

targetedResolutions.evidence: Large six-item two-row legend plus enlarged four function labels really visible at360; nucleus and mRNA export geometry independently rechecked.

nonblockingLimits: This overview is not a complete molecular sequence, codon/anticodon alignment, processing assay or real protein-function measurement. Function icons are symbolic. No new P/source/native claim.
images.actorAndOutsideViewerPerspective: No learner/instructor characters or action-selection perspective in these diagrams; outside viewer sees consistent labelled schematic compartments and directional arrows. No technical tools/editor inside product scene.
images.comicFormatAgeAndGoalFit: PNG landscape approx16:9, friendly clear comic schematic with rounded panels, strong contrast and simple colours; appropriate for upper-school mechanism overview. No gratuitous distress, diagnosis, stereotype or unsupported patient claim.

wholeCurrentGoal.title: Virale Vermehrung und Wirts-Proteinbiosynthese erklären
wholeCurrentGoal.titleEn: Explain Viral Replication and Host Protein Biosynthesis
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann den Eingriff von Viren in die Proteinbiosynthese ihres Wirts und den Vermehrungszyklus von Viren beschreiben, um Auswirkungen auf den Wirt und mögliche Therapieansätze zu erläutern.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can describe how viruses interfere with host protein biosynthesis and viral replication cycles to explain effects on the host and possible therapeutic approaches.

images.scientificMechanism: HIV model follows1 RNA→DNA in cytoplasm,2 DNA integration in host nuclear DNA,3 transcription to new red RNA,4 host ribosome translation to protein,5 RNA plus protein assembly and budding,6 protease-like scissors cleavage/reorganization from immature spherical lattice to mature conical core. The new RNA panel sends separate red arrows toward translation and RNA packaging; the blue protein branch joins assembly. This explicitly avoids interpreting proteins alone as new genomic RNA. Nuclear proviral DNA stays integrated; viral RNA goes to the cytoplasm.
images.scientificFormAndGeometry: The entering mature HIV and the right Reif particle have recognizably tapered cone/truncated-cone cores, whereas the immature particles have a spherical peripheral bead lattice. This is the relevant mature-vs-immature structural distinction documented by the previously independently read Zhao2013 primary HIV-capsid research. Budding membrane geometry and arrow flow1→2→3 branching4/5→6 are coherent. Scissors denote maturation cleavage; they are not a claim of clinical drug efficacy.
images.phoneReadability: At actual360×203 HIV, RNA→DNA, Integration, Neue RNA, Proteine, Aufbau+Knospung, Reifung, Unreif/Reif and Ribosom are directly readable. Six large numbered panels and the red branch/blue synthesis arrows remain distinguishable; the previous microscopic integration/RNA/protein keys are gone.
images.desktopAndOriginalReadability: At680×383 and1672×941 all stage headings, particle core shapes, RNA branch and ribosome are clear. No mislabeled direction, missing core transition or visual clipping seen.

targetedResolutions.evidence: Actual mature entering and Reif particle cores are visibly tapered rather than predecessor faceted polygon shells; immature sphere explicitly distinct.
Six enlarged panel labels and Ribosom/Unreif/Reif remain readable at360.

nonblockingLimits: Bounded HIV cycle example, not all virus families; condensed release/uncoating/transport, transcriptional isoforms and enzyme choreography; scissor symbol provides a mechanism for a possible protease target but no measured treatment outcome or resistance claim. The new large-heading model has six illustrated stages rather than implying one mandatory seven-step taxonomy.
images.actorAndOutsideViewerPerspective: No learner/instructor characters or action-selection perspective in these diagrams; outside viewer sees consistent labelled schematic compartments and directional arrows. No technical tools/editor inside product scene.
images.comicFormatAgeAndGoalFit: PNG landscape approx16:9, friendly clear comic schematic with rounded panels, strong contrast and simple colours; appropriate for upper-school mechanism overview. No gratuitous distress, diagnosis, stereotype or unsupported patient claim.
